scope: Three existing GT-mask cases, fixed frame0/seed42, inference only
wrong_type_vectors: Diagnostic only; excluded from conditional angle means but retained as type failures.

primary.protocol: Explicit GT-mask / oracle part segmentation. GT mesh only projected to2D mask; no GT axis/type/origin passed to PAct.
primary.selection: Fixed frame0 and seed42; no GT axis passed to model; correspondence from input-mask reorder, not GT joint-error permutation.
primary.direction_alignment: Fixed PAct export canonical frame to VideoArtGS GT-world R, from official source conventions; no fitted rotation or ICP.
primary.position_alignment: One uniform scale from static-part AABB diagonals and translation from static AABB centers; uses GT static geometry for evaluation only, never GT joint axis.
primary.unit_note: Distances in GT dataset-coordinate units and percent static diagonal, not claimed physically calibrated centimeters.
primary.angle_definition: acos(abs(dot(unit directions))) in degrees, ignores axis sign.
primary.pivot_definition: Distance from predicted origin to GT infinite axis, plus shortest infinite-axis line distance. Along-axis origin offset not identifiable; nonparallel intersecting infinite lines can have zero line distance despite a poor pivot.
primary.GT_joint_ranges_comparison: Not scored: input is a nonzero articulated state and generated rest-state convention may differ. GT limits and predicted range retained for diagnosis.

registration_sensitivity.protocol: Evaluation-only static-geometry local rigid ICP from fixed canonical initialization, 12000 surface samples, 80% trimmed point-to-point, at most50iterations. No GT joint axis/type/origin in fitting, no multistart or score-based rotation selection. No change to generated geometry or model.
registration_sensitivity.caveat: Static geometry may be symmetric or imperfect; registration-dependent joint error is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a replacement for the primary fixed-frame score.

input_provenance.protocol: Explicit GT-mask / oracle part segmentation. GT mesh only projected to2D mask; no GT axis/type/origin passed to PAct.
input_provenance.mask_labels: 0 background; mesh_index+1 foreground; original PAct bottom-up reorder recorded
